shot.continuity: one take, camera moving in every segment
shot.framing: vertical, the sunlit forest floor fills the lower half of frame

subject.character: female lynx walking unhurried through an autumn forest toward the lens, tufted ears, calm half-lidded eyes, a crumpled bill stuck to one paw
subject.physicality: heavy silent tread, shoulders rolling, never hurries, never looks back, flicks an ear instead of turning her head
subject.anti_action: steps over the wreckage without breaking stride, exactly as calm as before, tail perfectly still
subject.consistency: same lynx throughout; the beaver is the only other animal

props.iou: one crumpled overdue bill — printed form with ruled lines, a red stamp and columns of figures, no readable words: stuck to her paw, flicked off, snatched from the beaver, trodden into the water
props.dam: the beaver's dam with a plank desk and stacks of the same printed bills

environment: autumn forest, low sun through the trunks, fallen leaves, a stream and a beaver dam
lighting: low sun straight down the forest floor — leaves and paper are the brightest surfaces, warm rim on her back, cool shade behind the trunks

audio.delivery: unhurried, low, satisfied female voice. Stress: kre-dee-TO-ry, never KRE-dee-to-ry
audio.pacing: three lines, no gaps, inside 0.6-1.6, 1.6-2.5, 2.5-4.0. Nothing spoken after 4.0
audio.lip_sync: jaw and lips shape every syllable, the voice comes from the lynx herself
audio.pronunciation: кредиторы = kre-dee-TO-ry, stress on the third syllable

timeline.a: a heavy paw crushes a dry leaf right at the lens, the IOU note stuck to her pad. Silent
timeline.cam: ground-level lens under the paw, rising with her step

timeline.a: spoken calmly. She flicks the note off her pad without breaking stride, it spins away
timeline.cam: pushes in from the paw up to her face

timeline.line: А вот мои кредиторы? Не очень
timeline.a: spoken calmly. Behind her shoulder a beaver at his dam desk waves a fistful of papers and slaps the desk
timeline.cam: orbits right, bringing the beaver into frame over her shoulder

timeline.line: У кого-то же должен быть плохой день
timeline.a: spoken calmly, straight after. She walks on, snatching the top paper off his desk in passing without looking
timeline.cam: tracks alongside her past the dam

timeline.a: silent from here on. The beaver bolts after her, his whole stack going up into the air
timeline.cam: swings back to the beaver as the papers rise

timeline.a: she steps over a fallen trunk without changing pace, tail still
timeline.cam: cranes low along the trunk with her

timeline.a: the beaver slams into the trunk at full speed and folds over it
timeline.cam: holds low as he hits, papers raining

timeline.a: the dam gives way behind him, water bursting through with all his paper
timeline.cam: swings up to the dam breaking open

timeline.a: the water takes the beaver off his feet and carries him past the lens
timeline.cam: tracks him going by in the water

timeline.a: she stops, licks a paw twice, ear flicking at the noise behind her
the snatched paper drifts down into the water in front of her. She treads it under and walks on into the sun
timeline.cam: follows the paper down, then rises with her walking away

negative_prompt: speech after 4.1 s, the beaver speaking, a second lynx, money, coins, banknotes, pauses between lines, drawn-out delivery, the lynx running, the lynx looking back, holding still, freezing, duplicate props, floating objects, dim scene, dark foreground, locked-off camera, slow camera move, snap zoom, whip pan, readable words on the paper, subtitles, watermark, English speech, foreign accent, extra limbs
